game.title: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City – The Definitive Edition
game.notes: Mirror list (ruleset v2.1, Account-tracked achievements). The player confirmed on 2026-11-13 that their Rockstar Games Social Club account tracks this game's accomplishments for the Nintendo Switch version, so the Social Club page is the verification source for every entry, including counter-based ones the game itself does not display. Imported 1:1 at the player's request: the Social Club list has 43 entries (gta.wiki and gtabase agree on names and descriptions but may share lineage; socialclub.rockstargames.com was not reached directly, so confidence is medium) - the 33 PS4/PS5 gameplay trophies, the Platinum counterpart 'Kingpin' (replaced by Pantheon's own Platinum, Rule 18) and 9 Social Club-only accomplishments (origin native-other, tiers assigned under Rule 5). gta.wiki labels the 9 as Social Club-exclusive but one of its pages calls Retro Lewk a PS trophy; they are absent from the PS list, so they are tagged native-other. Filter (Rules 10, 20, 21) was waived by the player's choice; Prune found no entry clearly needing content missing on Switch (Deluxo for Don't Need Roads and the Cherry Popper subgame for Vice Vice Baby were not explicitly verified on Switch). City Sleuth tier: gtabase says Gold, PowerPyx Silver; Gold kept because gtabase's tiers match the PS 1/5/9/19 totals. 'Offender' reads 'Attain 50 wanted starts' in both sources - treated as a typo for stars. IDs 001-026 and the Platinum (027) are unchanged from v1.0 so recorded progress survives; restored and new entries take 028-045 in import order (restored console entries first, then Social Club-only). The two original v1.0 trophies (Street Legend, Neon Arena) are kept. The count exceeds Rule 4's 40-trophy reference because the mirror is 1:1. Mission-condition trophies stay flagged MISSABLE because mission replay is unconfirmed in the Definitive Edition. Take the Cannoli's Godfather threshold was reportedly lowered to 100,000 in patch 1.02; keep the Switch version updated. Cheats are reported to block achievements on other platforms; assume a cheat-free save.
